personal.title: AI Dietary Recipe
personal.summary: An AI-assisted recipe application that adapts suggestions to available time, cuisine and dietary requirements.
personal.description: Web application that provides personalized recipe suggestions based on user-selected criteria such as amount of time, cuisine type, dietary restrictions, and religious dietary preferences. contribution.description: Bigcapital is a smart and open-source accounting and inventory software, Bigcapital keeps all business finances in right place and automates accounting processes to give the business powerful and intelligent financial statements and reports to help in making decisions.

professional.title: Anthem Price Monitor
professional.description: A private price-intelligence platform that consolidates competitor product and pricing data into a secure, filterable workspace for faster commercial review.
professional.summary: A private price-intelligence platform for monitoring competitor catalogues, comparing products and reviewing commercial signals.
professional.contribution: Designed and delivered the end-to-end monitoring workflow, joining automated catalog discovery and reconciliation with a responsive analysis interface and a production API engineered for bounded, predictable performance.
highlights: Granular API endpoints reduce over-fetching and keep operational views focused.
Filter-aware SQL queries use capped result sets, cached summary and domain responses, and tuned SQLAlchemy connection pooling.
Rate limiting, security headers and safe error envelopes strengthen the production API boundary.
professional.altImage: Anthem Workwear Price Monitor showing competitor price filters and a product comparison matrix

professional.title: Anthem Forecast App
professional.description: A private inventory-forecasting workspace that connects sales, stock and purchase-order data to demand forecasts, stock projections and recommended buying decisions.
professional.summary: A private forecasting workspace that turns sales, stock and purchase-order data into clearer buying decisions.
professional.contribution: Built an authenticated decision-support application that translates complex inventory data into traceable forecasts and purchasing signals for operational users.
highlights: Combines statistical forecasting with current stock, safety-stock and lead-time assumptions.
Supports date-aware monthly stock projections and existing purchase-order arrivals.
Uses virtualised, query-driven interfaces to keep large operational datasets responsive.
professional.altImage: Anthem Inventory Forecast App secure sign-in screen

professional.title: Integrated Operational Manager of Securities
professional.summary: A tariffing and reporting system connecting securities operations, service-fee calculation and daily stakeholder reporting.
professional.description: Aims to serve as the tariffing and reporting system for the Fiduciary and Securities Department at the Central Bank of Colombia. Its primary function is to act as the conduit for operational transformation between the SEN trading system and the CSD. Additionally, it is tasked with calculating fees for the utilization of various FSD services and producing daily reports for stakeholders.
professional.altImage: Screenshot of the Integrated Operational Manager of Securities (GOIN)

professional.title: Porvenir Digital Transformation
professional.summary: An IBM BPM programme that streamlined pension workflows to improve processing speed, accuracy and responsiveness.
professional.description: The Porvenir Digital Transformation project involved the implementation of an IBM BPM (Business Process Management) system aimed at revolutionizing the management of pensions for Colombians. The system was designed to significantly reduce processing times for individuals reaching retirement age and eligibility milestones, ensuring faster disbursement of pension funds. By streamlining and automating workflows, Porvenir sought to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and responsiveness in pension processing, ultimately improving the overall customer experience and operational effectiveness.
professional.altImage: Screenshot of the Pension Fund Porvenir Digital Transformation Software

professional.title: Provider of Valuation Prices

professional.description: Precia's software platform provides up-to-date valuation prices for a variety of financial instruments, including fixed income securities, equities, derivatives, and structured products.
